ai_language_tip: Speak polite standard Turkish (tr) with 'siz' and Bey/Hanım; English works at hotels, private hospitals and tourist areas of Istanbul, Antalya and Izmir but rarely elsewhere.
english_ok: sometimes — Common at hotels, private hospitals and tourist areas; limited at esnaf shops, garages, public hospitals and government offices.
politeness: Formal and warm: open with iyi günler or merhaba, use siz and Bey/Hanım, soften with 'rica etsem'; close with teşekkür ederim, iyi günler.
name_tip: Address with first name + Bey/Hanım ('Ahmet Bey'), not the surname; bookings go under first name + surname + mobile.
phone_tip: Mobile 11 digits starting 05 (05XX 123 45 67); Istanbul landline 0212/0216 123 45 67; read back 4-3-2-2; WhatsApp usually the same mobile.
time_tip: CRITICAL: 'yedi buçuk' = 7:30; 'sekize çeyrek var' = 7:45; 'yediyi çeyrek geçe' = 7:15; written 19.30 or 19:30; dates are day.month (25.11).
number_tip: Read mobile numbers in groups (05XX / 123 / 45 / 67 pattern); prices in TL with dots as thousand separators; 'buçuk' = and a half.
avoid_calling: Avoid lunch 12:00–13:30, restaurant peak 19:30–21:30, calls after 21:00, and the Ramazan and Kurban Bayramı holidays when many businesses close for days.
closed_days: Office weekend is Sat–Sun (Saturday half days in some sectors); most shops open Sat and many on Sun; Ramazan and Kurban Bayramı close many businesses for several days.
booking_channels: WhatsApp and phone dominate for restaurants, salons, garages and small clinics; MHRS (ALO 182, web, app) for public hospital appointments; Yemeksepeti/Getir/Trendyol Go for delivery; BiTaksi/taxi stands for rides; e-Devlet for government.
voice_menu: Telcos (Turkcell, Vodafone, Türk Telekom), banks, ALO 182 and electricity/gas distributors use IVR; small businesses answer directly.
callback_habits: Businesses confirm by WhatsApp or SMS; MHRS sends SMS confirmations and reminders; private hospitals call or SMS the day before.

activity.before_dialing_zh: 卡帕多奇亞熱氣球、遊船與導覽多線上或 WhatsApp 預約；社區足球場（halı saha）習慣電話訂時段。

may_come_up.what: Balloon flight may be cancelled by weather on the morning
Halı saha slot paid per hour, kapora to secure it

sensitive_asked.what: Asks passport details for balloon passenger list

beauty.before_dialing_zh: 理髮（berber）與美髮（kuaför）多電話或 WhatsApp 預約，婚禮季週末與新娘造型要很早；部分沙龍用線上預約連結。

may_come_up.what: Bridal hair and make-up need a kapora and a trial
Berber often accepts walk-ins

sensitive_asked.what: Asks IBAN prepayment for a simple haircut

usually_asked: Service: kesim, fön, boya, manikür, ağda

change.before_dialing_zh: 改期或取消多電話或 WhatsApp 即可；MHRS 預約要在系統或打 182 取消，不要只是不到。

may_come_up.what: MHRS appointments must be cancelled in the system or via 182
Kapora not returned for late cancellation

sensitive_asked.what: Asks T.C. kimlik number to find the MHRS appointment

usually_asked: Name and mobile of the booking
Number of people if a restaurant

clinic.before_dialing_zh: 公立醫院與家庭醫師須用 MHRS（電話 182、網站或 App）以 T.C. 身分證號預約；私立醫院可直接電話、WhatsApp 或醫院 App 預約。

may_come_up.what: Public hospital slots are only given through MHRS or ALO 182
Private hospital asks if the patient has SGK or private insurance

sensitive_asked.what: Asks T.C. kimlik number and mother's/father's name

usually_asked: SGK or private insurance or self-pay

customer_service.before_dialing_zh: 電信（Turkcell、Vodafone、Türk Telekom）、銀行與水電瓦斯客服有語音選單，帳戶事項須本人以 T.C. 身分證號驗證。

may_come_up.what: Operator says changes need the line owner

sensitive_asked.what: Asks T.C. number, customer number or SMS code

government_school.before_dialing_zh: 行政手續多走 e-Devlet 或預約後到場；學校可電話詢問，週末不接。

may_come_up.what: Most documents are downloaded from e-Devlet

sensitive_asked.what: Asks the e-Devlet password or T.C. number

home_service.before_dialing_zh: 水電、冷氣與清潔多電話或用 Armut 等平台叫；Armut 清潔是線上選時段並刷卡付款，可免費改期。

may_come_up.what: Armut cleaning is booked online with card payment
Usta quotes after seeing the job

sensitive_asked.what: Asks money before coming for a small repair

hotel.before_dialing_zh: 飯店多經 Booking.com、Etstur、Jolly 等平台與官網，小旅館常電話或 WhatsApp；入住須出示身分證或護照登記。

may_come_up.what: ID or passport recorded at check-in
All-inclusive or room-only price

sensitive_asked.what: Asks card details on WhatsApp for prepayment

inquiry.before_dialing_zh: 詢問營業時間、宗教節日（Bayram）是否營業、可否刷卡或分期、有無停車位、是否供酒。

may_come_up.what: Gives Bayram opening days
Says card and instalment (taksit) options

pet.before_dialing_zh: 獸醫診所與寵物美容多可電話或 WhatsApp 預約；寵物旅館要看疫苗卡與晶片紀錄。

may_come_up.what: Grooming price by breed and coat
Vet asks for the vaccination card (aşı karnesi)

sensitive_asked.what: Pet hotel asks full IBAN prepayment to an individual

property.before_dialing_zh: 租屋多看 sahibinden.com、Hepsiemlak、Emlakjet，仲介（emlakçı）與房東習慣電話或 WhatsApp 約看房；常收押金（depozito）與仲介費。

may_come_up.what: Emlakçı arranges viewing by phone
Depozito and one month commission

sensitive_asked.what: Asks kapora before seeing the flat

repair.before_dialing_zh: 汽車保養多到原廠服務站或工業區（sanayi）小廠；原廠可電話或網站預約，小廠多直接到場。

may_come_up.what: Authorised service books periodic maintenance online
Sanayi workshop quotes after looking at the car

restaurant.before_dialing_zh: 土耳其餐廳多用電話或 WhatsApp 訂位，海景或露台座與週末晚上要提早；跨年、情人節等特殊晚會常是固定套餐並收訂金（kapora）。

may_come_up.what: Special-night set menu needs a kapora by IBAN transfer
Restaurant replies on WhatsApp with the menu and confirms the table
Meyhane table booked for a set time with fixed menu (fix menü)

sensitive_asked.what: Asks card number to guarantee a New Year's Eve table

usually_asked: Terrace, sea view, smoking or non-smoking area
Alcohol served or not (some places are alcohol-free)

shop_order.before_dialing_zh: 蛋糕店（pastane）、花店與節日甜點（baklava）常電話或 WhatsApp 預訂，宗教節日前要提早。

may_come_up.what: Baklava orders by the kilo or tray before Bayram

sensitive_asked.what: Asks full IBAN payment to a personal name

takeout.before_dialing_zh: 餐廳普遍提供電話點餐自取或外送（paket servis），平台以 Yemeksepeti、Getir、Trendyol Go 為主。

may_come_up.what: Delivery handled through Yemeksepeti or the shop's own courier
Card machine brought to the door for payment

sensitive_asked.what: Asks IBAN transfer before preparing a small paket order

tracking.before_dialing_zh: PTT、Yurtiçi、Aras、MNG 多為語音選單，建議用官網或 App 以追蹤號（takip no）查件。

may_come_up.what: Courier site shows status by takip number

transport.before_dialing_zh: 計程車多在路邊、計程車站（taksi durağı）電話叫或用 BiTaksi；機場接送（transfer）可電話或 WhatsApp 預約。

may_come_up.what: Suggests calling the nearest taksi durağı or using BiTaksi
Airport transfer fixed price per vehicle

sensitive_asked.what: Car rental asks licence and credit card
